title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
description: Several White House staffers are using devices with residential proxy services that allow others to rent their internet addresses, including a Russian proxy service linked to past election cyberattacks. Security firms detected persistent proxy activity originating from the White House network (AS2650) involving multiple proxy providers, enabling public access to these IP addresses. Residential proxy services can anonymize traffic but also pose security risks, including facilitating malicious activities and exposing local networks to malware. These proxies often come from employee devices and have been found widely in government and corporate networks. Vulnerabilities in such services have been exploited to gain control over devices within local networks. This situation highlights significant security concerns for trusted government networks.
